message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/zstd/tests/fuzz && python3 -c "
import struct
magic = 0xFD2FB528
data = b'Hello World'
frame_header_desc = 0x20
block_header = (1 << 31) | (0 << 29) | len(data)
frame = struct.pack('<I', magic)
frame += struct.pack('B', frame_header_desc)
frame += struct.pack('<I', block_header)[:3]
frame += data
open('/tmp/test.zst', 'wb').write(frame)
print('Written', len(frame), 'bytes')
" && ./simple_decompress /tmp/test.zst && echo "SUCCESS" || echo "FAILED"
